options: The assembly hall of Makkah's leaders, like a parliament
questions.explain: Dar an-Nadwah was where Quraysh leaders gathered.

questions.q: Who are the hanifs or ahnaf?
options: Upright people who do not worship idols
questions.explain: Ahnaf is the plural of hanif.

questions.q: What does tahannuth mean according to this lecture?
options: Withdrawing to leave sin and indecency
questions.explain: Tahannuth is not asceticism; he kept engaging with society.

questions.q: How long did the Prophet's true dreams occur before revelation?
questions.explain: What he dreamed came true the next day.

questions.q: How many times did Jibril embrace the Prophet SAW while commanding 'Iqra'?
How did Khadijah test whether it was an angel?
options: She asked the Prophet SAW to sit on her lap
questions.explain: Khadijah stayed calm and sought answers while the Prophet SAW was afraid.

questions.q: Tahannuth means cutting off from society.
questions.explain: False. He withdrew while continuing to engage with society.

questions.q: Allah promised to preserve the Quran so that no one can change a letter or word.
Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW runs to Khadijah
He begins going to the Cave of Hira

questions.explain: He began going to Hira, true dreams, tahannuth, Jibril embraced him, then he ran to Khadijah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A true dream, the first form of revelation
A gift from Allah, a swift signal
The recipient of important news he must convey
The bearer of a new law

questions.explain: A nabi receives news, a rasul brings a new law, wahy is Allah's gift, and ru'ya sadiqa is the true dream.

questions.q: Learning religion without any change in oneself is merely what?
questions.explain: Read the sirah in order to change.
